class.name: RTReflections
class.brief_description: Real-time GPU BVH ray-traced reflections node using OpenGL 4.3 compute shaders.
class.description: Computes physically-based ray-traced specular reflections against scene meshes, dynamic skinned meshes, PBR textures, lights, sky radiance, and transparent/alpha-cutout materials via a two-level GPU BVH (TLAS/BLAS). Automatically attaches a reflection composite pass to eligible [SpatialMaterial]s in the scene, or exposes the traced reflection texture via [method get_reflection_texture] for custom shaders.

method.name: apply_quality_preset
method.description: Applies a scalability preset ([constant PRESET_LOW], [constant PRESET_MEDIUM], [constant PRESET_HIGH], or [constant PRESET_ULTRA]) across resolution, tracing, denoising, shadows, and mesh simplification settings.

method.name: get_reflection_texture
method.description: Returns the generated mipmapped RGBA16F reflection [Texture]. RGB holds linear HDR reflected radiance and A holds camera-to-surface distance (negative when invalid/sky).

method.name: mark_geometry_dirty
method.description: Forces the acceleration structures to rebuild on the next snapshot update.

members.member: Enables full material alpha awareness in both the reflection G-buffer and ray traversal, handling alpha-scissor cutouts and semi-transparent surfaces.
Maximum number of alpha-tested or semi-transparent surfaces a single reflection ray can penetrate per bounce before terminating. Higher values handle stacked foliage/glass at extra traversal cost.
If [code]true[/code], reflection rays pass through alpha-scissor holes and partially transmit through semi-transparent surfaces such as glass or water.
If [code]true[/code], shadow rays inside reflections respect alpha-scissor cutouts and attenuate through semi-transparent casters instead of casting solid black shadows.
Approximates secondary indirect bounce light inside reflections by wrapping directional light energy with sky irradiance. Set to [code]0.0[/code] to disable.
Custom ambient fill color used inside reflections when [member ambient_light_mode] is set to [constant AMBIENT_MODE_CUSTOM].
Multiplier for ambient light inside reflections when [member ambient_light_mode] is set to [constant AMBIENT_MODE_CUSTOM].
Controls how ambient lighting is resolved for hit surfaces inside reflections: inherited from the active [Environment], overridden with custom values, or disabled.
Blends between flat [member ambient_light_color] ([code]0.0[/code]) and sky spherical harmonics irradiance ([code]1.0[/code]) when [member ambient_light_mode] is [constant AMBIENT_MODE_CUSTOM].
Darkening strength of ray-traced ambient occlusion applied to ambient and indirect light on primary reflection hits.
Maximum ray distance (in meters) for ray-traced ambient occlusion hemisphere samples inside reflections.
Number of cosine-weighted hemisphere ambient occlusion rays traced per primary reflection hit. Set to [code]0[/code] to disable ray-traced ambient occlusion for maximum speed.
Scales the L2 spherical harmonics sky irradiance used to illuminate diffuse surfaces inside reflections.

Automatically injects a compositing [code]next_pass[/code] shader onto eligible transparent/alpha [SpatialMaterial]s that do not already define a custom [member Material.next_pass]. Opaque and alpha-scissor surfaces are composited onto the screen automatically when [member auto_composite] is enabled.
Automatically composites ray-traced reflections onto opaque surfaces on the active viewport before volumetric fog and 2D UI. Disable if manually sampling [method get_reflection_texture].
Uses depth-aware bilateral filtering when upsampling lower-resolution reflections onto full-resolution geometry edges, preventing haloing around foreground silhouettes.

Maximum number of new or invalidated mesh BLAS structures built per frame. Set to [code]0[/code] for unlimited builds, or a small number (e.g. [code]4[/code]-[code]8[/code]) to eliminate hitches when streaming large scenes.
Maximum mipmap level reached as material roughness approaches [code]1.0[/code].
Controls how strongly rough surfaces blur sampled reflections using mipmaps.
Multiplies [member max_ray_distance] after each reflection bounce to keep secondary bounce traversal fast.
If [code]true[/code], secondary and deeper reflection bounces also evaluate [OmniLight] and [SpotLight] illumination rather than only [DirectionalLight] and ambient sky.
Early-terminates multi-bounce ray paths once Fresnel throughput drops below this threshold.
Traces only half of the reflection pixels per frame in an alternating checkerboard pattern and reconstructs missing pixels from depth/normal-similar neighbors. Nearly doubles tracing performance.
Custom [ProceduralSky] or [PanoramaSky] resource used exclusively for reflections and reflection ambient radiance when [member custom_sky_mode] is [constant SKY_MODE_CUSTOM_SKY].
Solid reflection sky color used when [member custom_sky_mode] is set to [constant SKY_MODE_COLOR].
Brightness multiplier for [member custom_sky] or [member custom_sky_color].
Selects whether reflection rays and sky irradiance use the scene's active [Environment] sky, a dedicated [member custom_sky], or a flat [member custom_sky_color].
Euler rotation in degrees applied to the custom reflection sky orientation.
Increases sampled texture mipmap LOD as total ray path distance grows, improving texture cache coherence and reducing distant aliasing.
Enables real-time reflection rendering inside the 3D editor viewport.
Master toggle for ray-traced reflection capture, compute dispatch, and material compositing.
Blends sky environment reflection into glossy surfaces hit on the final bounce instead of stopping at diffuse shading alone.
Skips submitting off-screen meshes to the primary reflection G-buffer rasterization pass while keeping them active in the ray-traced TLAS so off-screen objects still appear in reflections.

Controls stochastic GGX reflection cone widening for rough surfaces when [member ray_samples_per_pixel] > 1, [member temporal_accumulation], or [member spatial_denoise_passes] > 0 is active. Set to [code]0.0[/code] for purely mirror-like ray directions.
Maximum distance from the camera (outside light range) beyond which local [OmniLight] and [SpotLight] nodes are excluded from reflection shading.
Maximum number of specular reflection bounces traced per ray.
Maximum world-space distance (in meters) a primary reflection ray travels before falling back to the sky.
Dielectric surfaces rougher than this value stop tracing reflection rays and fade out smoothly over [member roughness_fade_range]. Metallic surfaces ignore this cutoff.
Maximum unique textures packed into the GPU texture array for hit shading. Increasing this uses more VRAM.
Caps the maximum number of nearest mesh instances inserted into the ray-traced TLAS per frame. Set to [code]0[/code] for unlimited instances.
Distance beyond which small objects with angular size below [member mesh_cull_min_angle] are omitted from reflections.
Minimum bounding-sphere angular radius (in radians) required for objects farther than [member mesh_cull_distance] to remain in reflections. Set to [code]0.0[/code] to disable small-object culling.
Simplifies high-polygon meshes when building ray-tracing BLAS acceleration structures to dramatically improve BVH build times, VRAM usage, and traversal speed.

If [code]true[/code], the primary reflection G-buffer pass also renders the simplified proxy geometry instead of the original mesh. Leave [code]false[/code] to keep razor-sharp surface normals on primary receivers while tracing simplified BLAS proxies.
Maximum normalized geometric QEM error (as a fraction of mesh bounding diagonal) permitted during edge collapse. Set to [code]0.0[/code] to always simplify down to [member mesh_simplification_ratio].
Meshes with triangle counts at or below this threshold are never simplified.

Algorithm used to simplify meshes: [constant SIMPLIFY_QEM] preserves silhouette and UV boundaries at high quality; [constant SIMPLIFY_VERTEX_CLUSTERING] simplifies ultra-fast via spatial grid quantization.
Applies boundary plane penalties and UV/material/normal seam preservation during simplification to prevent holes or stretched textures.
Target triangle retention fraction (e.g. [code]0.5[/code] reduces triangles by 50%).
Allows simplifying skeletal skinned meshes as well as static meshes.
Evaluates surface normal maps on ray-traced bounce hits using triangle-space TBN derivation. Disable for faster bounce shading.
Maximum bounce depth at which hit surfaces sample roughness, metallic, normal, and ambient occlusion textures.
Surface normal offset applied to ray origins to eliminate self-intersection acne.
Number of reflection rays traced per pixel on rough/glossy surfaces. Mirror-smooth surfaces always trace 1 ray.
Visual layer mask controlling which [MeshInstance] nodes appear inside reflections.
Mipmap sampling filter used for rough reflections in the composite pass ([constant FILTER_BILINEAR] or [constant FILTER_BICUBIC]).
Overall intensity multiplier applied to composited reflections.
Resolution scale of the reflection trace buffer relative to the active viewport size.
Visual layer mask controlling which [MeshInstance] nodes receive ray-traced reflections.
Honors each [SpatialMaterial]'s [member SpatialMaterial.params_cull_mode] (Back, Front, Disabled) during G-buffer rendering, ray intersection, and composite next-pass shaders.
Smoothly fades reflection alpha between [code]max_roughness - roughness_fade_range[/code] and [member max_roughness] on dielectric surfaces.
Maximum reflection bounce depth at which direct light shadow rays are traced.
Maximum ray path distance from the camera within which reflected surfaces trace shadow rays.
Surface normal offset applied to shadow and AO ray origins to avoid self-shadowing acne.
Enables real-time CPU skinning and fast bottom-up BVH refitting so animated characters appear in reflections.
Independent brightness multiplier for direct sky reflections without altering diffuse ambient sky irradiance.
Number of edge-aware A-Trous bilateral spatial denoising passes executed on rough reflections while keeping mirror reflections sharp.
Reprojects previous-frame reflection data using world-space position and neighborhood color clamping to converge glossy/AO/checkerboard noise over time.
Weight of the current frame when [member temporal_accumulation] is enabled. Lower values produce smoother convergence at the cost of slight inertia.
Square resolution of each slice in the GPU texture array used to shade reflected hits. Lowering this saves significant VRAM.
Global mipmap LOD bias added when sampling textures on reflected hits.
Enables ray-traced direct light shadows on surfaces seen inside reflections.
Increases reflection visibility on low-alpha transparent surfaces (such as glass or water) at grazing Fresnel angles.
Minimum alpha required for a transparent material to write into the reflection G-buffer pass when [member transparent_receivers] is enabled.
Allows semi-transparent surfaces (such as glass windows and water planes) to receive and display ray-traced reflections.
Executes reflection tracing once every N frames. Increasing this to [code]2[/code] or [code]3[/code] scales GPU cost proportionally on lower-end hardware.

constants.constant: Fast hardware bilinear mipmap filtering for rough reflection blurring.
Smooth 16-tap B-spline bicubic mipmap filtering for rough reflection blurring.
Quarter-resolution checkerboard tracing with vertex-clustering mesh simplification, no shadows, and 256px textures.
Half-resolution tracing with QEM mesh simplification, 1-bounce shadows, and 1-sample ray-traced AO.
Three-quarter-resolution multi-bounce tracing with temporal accumulation, spatial denoising, and 2-sample ray-traced AO.
Full-resolution 2-spp multi-bounce tracing with 2 spatial denoise passes, 3-sample AO, and 1024px textures.
Uses the active viewport [Environment] sky or background color.
Overrides the reflection sky and irradiance with [member custom_sky].
Overrides the reflection sky and irradiance with a uniform [member custom_sky_color].
Inherits ambient color, energy, and sky contribution from the active [Environment].
Uses custom [member ambient_light_color], [member ambient_light_energy], and [member ambient_light_sky_contribution] inside reflections.
Disables ambient fill inside reflections so only direct lighting, bounce fill, and emissives contribute.
Quadric Error Metric edge collapse preserving silhouettes, UV seams, and material boundaries.
Fast uniform 3D spatial grid clustering for rapid BLAS generation on dense meshes.
